metadata.access_mode: read-only metadata and explicitly limited non-PII product configuration queries
collection_methods: Supabase CLI generated types from production metadata
Supabase Management API non-PII plan/package SELECT

mobile_application.configuration: capacitor.config.ts production server URL → https://cloudandcorestudio.com; browser client reads VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

admin_dashboard.configuration: Cloud Run build path in cloudbuild.yaml injects VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID, VITE_SUPABASE_URL, and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; server client reads SUPABASE_URL

verification_evidence: existing VITE_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_URL matched the reference without exposing values
successful production migration and catalog metadata reads through the linked project

comparison.adults: MATCHES_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH for the four active commercial prices and credit/duration combinations.
comparison.kids_monthly: The ₪280 / 4-lesson price-and-credit combination matches. Production also configures total_periods=10, which the source of truth does not specify.
comparison.kids_ten_month: PRODUCTION CONFIGURATION / SOURCE-OF-TRUTH CONFLICT: production configures ₪2,500 as 4 credits per period × 10 periods (40 lessons), while the source of truth says 35 lessons / 10 months.
comparison.inactive_test_plan: An inactive ₪1 HYP test plan exists outside the commercial source of truth.

limitations: No customer, membership, booking, attendance, payment, provider-event, receipt, message, or audit rows were queried or exported.

No Edge Functions were returned by the deployed-function listing; function code and secret configuration were not inspected.
Routine signatures, policy names, trigger names, and index definitions are included; routine bodies and RLS predicates are intentionally excluded.
